answer: By tying sybil resistance to network topology, the protocol anchors identities in the meadow, a global routing graph mapping autonomous system paths. Each spawned falcon must burn river, defined as non-overlapping BGP prefix leases staked in BTC. The meadow prices river by squaring the BTC bond for every additional identity routing through the same upstream transit provider. Clones from one cloud host collide on shared transit links, forcing the attacker's BTC bill to grow quadratically per falcon, failing only if the attacker hijacks global routing tables.
